args.title: Remember the last used export format in localStorage
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the last selected export format in localStorage so that the export format dropdown remembers the user's preference across page reloads instead of resetting to the default on every mount.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component currently initializes its export format state without persisting user selections to localStorage, so storing and reading the format preference from localStorage will satisfy this request.
